entry.title: New DjangoCon Europe 2025 schedule released (0.13)
entry.summary:
A new DjangoCon Europe 2025 schedule has been released!

We released a new schedule version!

We have a new session: “Build a static website with Django!” by Emma Delescolle.

Sadly, we had to cancel a session: “Simplifying Reusability: Packaging Django Apps for Distribution on PyPI” by Johanan Oppong Amoateng
